command: Saccharomyces cerevisiae FUN19 (P28003; YAL034C) has transcription coactivator activity and positively regulates DNA-templated transcription. Actual PANTHER tree confirms target PTN000271934 below root function node PTN000271860 and fungal PTN000271931. The latter retains Rpd3L-Expanded association but carries an explicit IRD loss of SAGA-type-complex membership (GO:0070461), not loss of coactivator activity. FUN19 lacks Ada2 ZZ/SANT domains but retains SWIRM; those losses may change complex context without eliminating every activation mechanism. Evaluate direct or ortholog evidence for transcriptional directionality and relevant interfaces. GO:0070210 is not fission-yeast-specific and chromatin remodeling does not require the target itself to be an ATPase. Distinguish generic chromatin/regulatory roles from positive coactivation and evaluate the actual ancestral judgment rather than treating a sibling-subfamily donor as automatically invalid.
